title: Song Centre — World Music Collection
description: A curated, child-friendly collection of songs spanning Bengali, Hindi, Urdu/Pakistani and international music — from folk and classical to pop, rock and world music. All songs are educational, safe for ages 5+ and include learning notes.

songs.title: Hey Jude
songs.description: A timeless anthem of encouragement written by Paul McCartney for John Lennon's son Julian.
songs.educational_notes: Features one of the longest sing-along codas in pop music history.
songs.fun_fact: Features one of the longest sing-along codas in pop music history.

songs.title: Let It Be
songs.description: Paul McCartney's piano ballad, one of the Beatles' final singles.
songs.educational_notes: The title echoes a phrase McCartney's mother used to comfort him.
songs.fun_fact: The title echoes a phrase McCartney's mother used to comfort him.

songs.title: Yesterday
songs.description: One of the most covered songs in history, written by Paul McCartney.
songs.educational_notes: Originally titled 'Scrambled Eggs' during composition.
songs.fun_fact: Originally titled 'Scrambled Eggs' during composition.

songs.title: Imagine
songs.description: John Lennon's utopian anthem for peace and unity.
songs.educational_notes: Recorded at Lennon's Tittenhurst Park home studio.
songs.fun_fact: Recorded at Lennon's Tittenhurst Park home studio.

songs.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.description: An operatic rock epic blending ballad, opera and hard rock sections.
songs.educational_notes: Freddie Mercury wrote it; the band spent three weeks recording the vocal harmonies.
songs.fun_fact: Freddie Mercury wrote it; the band spent three weeks recording the vocal harmonies.

songs.title: We Will Rock You
songs.description: Built on a stomp-stomp-clap rhythm that audiences worldwide replicate.
songs.educational_notes: Written by Brian May as a song the audience could perform along with the band.
songs.fun_fact: Written by Brian May as a song the audience could perform along with the band.

songs.title: Don't Stop Me Now
songs.description: An exuberant celebration of joy and freedom by Freddie Mercury.
songs.educational_notes: Voted the greatest song to make you feel happy in a UK poll.
songs.fun_fact: Voted the greatest song to make you feel happy in a UK poll.

songs.title: Rolling in the Deep
songs.description: Adele's global breakthrough smash about heartbreak and empowerment.
songs.educational_notes: Won three Grammy Awards including Record of the Year.
songs.fun_fact: Won three Grammy Awards including Record of the Year.

songs.title: Someone Like You
songs.description: A tearful piano ballad about moving on after lost love.
songs.educational_notes: Adele wrote it after a real breakup; the opening piano is now instantly recognisable.
songs.fun_fact: Adele wrote it after a real breakup; the opening piano is now instantly recognisable.

songs.title: Shape of You
songs.description: One of the best-selling singles of all time with a tropical pop sound.
songs.educational_notes: Spent 14 weeks at number 1 in the UK.
songs.fun_fact: Spent 14 weeks at number 1 in the UK.

songs.title: Perfect
songs.description: A romantic waltz-tempo ballad celebrating love.
songs.educational_notes: Inspired by Ed Sheeran's then-girlfriend Cherry Seaborn.
songs.fun_fact: Inspired by Ed Sheeran's then-girlfriend Cherry Seaborn.

songs.title: Space Oddity
songs.description: A song about astronaut Major Tom, inspired by 2001: A Space Odyssey.
songs.educational_notes: Released just days before the Apollo 11 Moon landing.
songs.fun_fact: Released just days before the Apollo 11 Moon landing.

songs.title: Heroes
songs.description: Inspired by the Berlin Wall, a song of hope between divided lovers.
songs.educational_notes: Recorded partly outdoors to capture ambient Berlin sounds.
songs.fun_fact: Recorded partly outdoors to capture ambient Berlin sounds.
awards: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

songs.title: Hotel California
songs.description: A surreal, cinematic tale of hedonism and excess in 1970s California.
songs.educational_notes: The famous guitar outro is played by Don Felder and Joe Walsh trading licks.
songs.fun_fact: The famous guitar outro is played by Don Felder and Joe Walsh trading licks.

songs.title: Take It Easy
songs.description: A laid-back anthem co-written with Jackson Browne, launching the Eagles' career.
songs.educational_notes: The corner in Winslow, Arizona mentioned in the lyrics has a commemorative statue.
songs.fun_fact: The corner in Winslow, Arizona mentioned in the lyrics has a commemorative statue.
awards: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

songs.title: Go Your Own Way
songs.description: Lindsey Buckingham's bitter breakup song directed at Stevie Nicks.
songs.educational_notes: From Rumours, one of the best-selling albums of all time.
songs.fun_fact: From Rumours, one of the best-selling albums of all time.
awards: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

songs.title: Dreams
songs.description: Stevie Nicks' only US number 1 hit, also a viral TikTok phenomenon in 2020.
songs.educational_notes: The only song on Rumours written entirely by one member (Nicks).
songs.fun_fact: The only song on Rumours written entirely by one member (Nicks).

songs.title: Waterloo
songs.description: Won Eurovision Song Contest 1974 and launched ABBA to global stardom.
songs.educational_notes: Named after Napoleon's historic defeat at the Battle of Waterloo.
songs.fun_fact: Named after Napoleon's historic defeat at the Battle of Waterloo.

songs.title: Dancing Queen
songs.description: ABBA's only US number 1 hit, a euphoric disco anthem.
songs.educational_notes: Written in a single night by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus.
songs.fun_fact: Written in a single night by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus.

songs.title: Thriller
songs.description: The best-selling album's title track with a famous horror-film video.
songs.educational_notes: The Thriller music video is the first to be inducted into the US National Film Registry.
songs.fun_fact: The Thriller music video is the first to be inducted into the US National Film Registry.

songs.title: Billie Jean
songs.description: Michael Jackson introduced the moonwalk dance performing this song.
songs.educational_notes: Jackson spent four days mixing the song to get the bass drum sound right.
songs.fun_fact: Jackson spent four days mixing the song to get the bass drum sound right.

songs.title: Man in the Mirror
songs.description: An uplifting call for personal responsibility and social change.
songs.educational_notes: Features the Winans and Andraé Crouch Choir on backing vocals.
songs.fun_fact: Features the Winans and Andraé Crouch Choir on backing vocals.

songs.title: I Will Always Love You
songs.description: Whitney Houston's record-breaking ballad, originally written by Dolly Parton.
songs.educational_notes: Spent 14 weeks at US #1; one of the best-selling singles of all time.
songs.fun_fact: Spent 14 weeks at US #1; one of the best-selling singles of all time.

songs.title: Greatest Love of All
songs.description: An anthem celebrating self-love and belief in children's futures.
songs.educational_notes: Originally recorded by George Benson for the Muhammad Ali biopic.
songs.fun_fact: Originally recorded by George Benson for the Muhammad Ali biopic.

songs.title: Respect
songs.album: I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You
songs.description: Aretha Franklin's feminist anthem, spelling out R-E-S-P-E-C-T.
songs.educational_notes: Originally written and recorded by Otis Redding; Franklin transformed its meaning.
songs.fun_fact: Originally written and recorded by Otis Redding; Franklin transformed its meaning.
awards: Grammy Award, Grammy Hall of Fame

songs.title: What a Wonderful World
songs.description: Louis Armstrong's gentle celebration of the beauty of the natural world.
songs.educational_notes: Became a worldwide hit after being featured in the film Good Morning, Vietnam.
songs.fun_fact: Became a worldwide hit after being featured in the film Good Morning, Vietnam.

songs.title: Summertime
songs.description: From Gershwin's opera Porgy and Bess; one of the most recorded songs ever.
songs.educational_notes: Over 33,000 cover versions have been recorded worldwide.
songs.fun_fact: Over 33,000 cover versions have been recorded worldwide.

songs.title: Fly Me to the Moon
songs.album: It Might as Well Be Swing
songs.description: Frank Sinatra's signature swing number, now synonymous with the Space Age.
songs.educational_notes: Became the first music played on the Moon during Apollo 10.
songs.fun_fact: Became the first music played on the Moon during Apollo 10.

songs.title: New York New York
songs.description: Frank Sinatra's rousing ode to ambition and New York City.
songs.educational_notes: Played at the end of every New York Yankees home game.
songs.fun_fact: Played at the end of every New York Yankees home game.

songs.title: Ring of Fire
songs.description: Johnny Cash's blazing love song co-written with June Carter.
songs.educational_notes: The mariachi-style horns were Cash's own idea, unusual for country music.
songs.fun_fact: The mariachi-style horns were Cash's own idea, unusual for country music.

songs.title: Jolene
songs.description: Dolly Parton's plea to a woman not to steal her man — a country icon.
songs.educational_notes: Inspired by a red-haired bank teller who flirted with Parton's husband.
songs.fun_fact: Inspired by a red-haired bank teller who flirted with Parton's husband.

songs.title: No Woman No Cry
songs.description: Bob Marley's comforting song to the poor of Trench Town, Kingston.
songs.educational_notes: The live version from the Lyceum, London (1975) is the most famous recording.
songs.fun_fact: The live version from the Lyceum, London (1975) is the most famous recording.

songs.title: One Love
songs.description: A joyful anthem of unity and peace, now an unofficial Jamaican national song.
songs.educational_notes: One Love/People Get Ready blends Marley's original with a Curtis Mayfield song.
songs.fun_fact: One Love/People Get Ready blends Marley's original with a Curtis Mayfield song.

songs.title: Three Little Birds
songs.description: One of reggae's most optimistic songs — 'Don't worry about a thing.'
songs.educational_notes: The 'three little birds' were real birds that would sit on Marley's windowsill.
songs.fun_fact: The 'three little birds' were real birds that would sit on Marley's windowsill.

songs.title: You Can Call Me Al
songs.description: Recorded in Johannesburg with South African musicians, blending pop and African rhythms.
songs.educational_notes: The music video features Chevy Chase lip-syncing while Simon plays.
songs.fun_fact: The music video features Chevy Chase lip-syncing while Simon plays.

songs.title: The Sound of Silence
songs.description: A haunting meditation on modern alienation and communication failure.
songs.educational_notes: Later remixed with electric instruments and became a massive hit in 1965.
songs.fun_fact: Later remixed with electric instruments and became a massive hit in 1965.

songs.title: Mrs Robinson
songs.description: Written for the film The Graduate; won Grammy for Record of the Year 1969.
songs.educational_notes: Simon wrote it in a hurry to meet the film's deadline.
songs.fun_fact: Simon wrote it in a hurry to meet the film's deadline.

songs.title: Blowin' in the Wind
songs.description: A rhetorical anthem of the civil rights and anti-war movements.
songs.educational_notes: Peter, Paul and Mary's cover reached #2 in the US, spreading the song globally.
songs.fun_fact: Peter, Paul and Mary's cover reached #2 in the US, spreading the song globally.

songs.title: Like a Rolling Stone
songs.description: Voted the greatest song of all time by Rolling Stone magazine (twice).
songs.educational_notes: Dylan wrote four pages of 'vomit' prose before shaping it into a song.
songs.fun_fact: Dylan wrote four pages of 'vomit' prose before shaping it into a song.

songs.title: Born in the USA
songs.description: A deceptively complex song about Vietnam veterans struggling at home.
songs.educational_notes: Often mistaken for a patriotic anthem; it is actually critical commentary.
songs.fun_fact: Often mistaken for a patriotic anthem; it is actually critical commentary.

songs.title: Purple Rain
songs.description: The emotional centrepiece of Prince's semi-autobiographical film of the same name.
songs.educational_notes: Prince performed it live in a real rainstorm during a famous concert.
songs.fun_fact: Prince performed it live in a real rainstorm during a famous concert.

songs.title: Like a Prayer
songs.description: A gospel-infused pop anthem blending religion, freedom and passion.
songs.educational_notes: The music video sparked significant cultural conversation about religion and race.
songs.fun_fact: The music video sparked significant cultural conversation about religion and race.

songs.title: Material Girl
songs.description: A tongue-in-cheek anthem that defined 1980s pop culture.
songs.educational_notes: The video paid homage to Marilyn Monroe's 'Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend'.
songs.fun_fact: The video paid homage to Marilyn Monroe's 'Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend'.

songs.title: Crazy in Love
songs.description: Beyoncé's debut solo single, featuring a horn sample from Chi-Lites' 'Are You My Woman'.
songs.educational_notes: Won two Grammy Awards including Best R&B Song.
songs.fun_fact: Won two Grammy Awards including Best R&B Song.

songs.title: Halo
songs.description: A sweeping power ballad about the healing power of love.
songs.educational_notes: Co-written with Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic.
songs.fun_fact: Co-written with Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic.

songs.title: Lose Yourself
songs.description: Eminem's Oscar-winning motivational anthem from the film 8 Mile.
songs.educational_notes: First rap song to win an Academy Award for Best Original Song.
songs.fun_fact: First rap song to win an Academy Award for Best Original Song.

songs.title: Under the Bridge
songs.description: Anthony Kiedis wrote it about his loneliness and drug addiction in LA.
songs.educational_notes: The bridge mentioned is the 6th Street Bridge in Los Angeles.
songs.fun_fact: The bridge mentioned is the 6th Street Bridge in Los Angeles.

songs.title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
songs.description: The defining anthem of 1990s grunge, written by Kurt Cobain.
songs.educational_notes: Kurt Cobain said he was trying to write a song that sounded like the Pixies.
songs.fun_fact: Kurt Cobain said he was trying to write a song that sounded like the Pixies.

songs.title: Wonderwall
songs.description: Noel Gallagher's acoustic classic, one of the most-played songs in UK pubs.
songs.educational_notes: 'Wonderwall' was borrowed from a 1968 George Harrison film score title.
songs.fun_fact: 'Wonderwall' was borrowed from a 1968 George Harrison film score title.

songs.title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
songs.description: The best-selling holiday single of all time, written in 15 minutes.
songs.educational_notes: Earned over $60 million in royalties for Carey and co-writer Walter Afanasieff.
songs.fun_fact: Earned over $60 million in royalties for Carey and co-writer Walter Afanasieff.

songs.title: Happy
songs.album: G I R L / Despicable Me 2
songs.description: A joyful, 24-hour music video was released with fans dancing across different hours.
songs.educational_notes: Won an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Song.
songs.fun_fact: Won an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Song.

songs.title: Get Lucky
songs.description: A retro-funk collaboration between Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers.
songs.educational_notes: Won Grammy Awards for Record of the Year and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance.
songs.fun_fact: Won Grammy Awards for Record of the Year and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance.

songs.title: Around the World
songs.description: The phrase 'around the world' is repeated 144 times, once per dancer in the video.
songs.educational_notes: Each group of dancers represents a different instrument in the track.
songs.fun_fact: Each group of dancers represents a different instrument in the track.

songs.title: La Vie en Rose
songs.description: France's most beloved song, Piaf's declaration of love-filled joy.
songs.educational_notes: Piaf wrote the lyrics herself after another songwriter provided the melody.
songs.fun_fact: Piaf wrote the lyrics herself after another songwriter provided the melody.

songs.title: Ne Me Quitte Pas
songs.description: One of the greatest songs in the French language, a heartbroken plea.
songs.educational_notes: Covered in many languages; the English version is 'If You Go Away'.
songs.fun_fact: Covered in many languages; the English version is 'If You Go Away'.

songs.title: Nessun Dorma
songs.description: The famous tenor aria from Puccini's opera Turandot, a worldwide audience favourite.
songs.educational_notes: Pavarotti's performance at the 1990 World Cup in Rome introduced it to billions.
songs.fun_fact: Pavarotti's performance at the 1990 World Cup in Rome introduced it to billions.

songs.title: The Four Seasons: Spring
songs.description: Vivaldi's most famous work, a programmatic depiction of seasonal nature sounds.
songs.educational_notes: Written in 1725 but only became widely known in the 20th century.
songs.fun_fact: Written in 1725 but only became widely known in the 20th century.

songs.title: Ode to Joy
songs.description: The finale of Beethoven's 9th Symphony, composed when he was completely deaf.
songs.educational_notes: The melody is now the official anthem of the European Union.
songs.fun_fact: The melody is now the official anthem of the European Union.

songs.title: Moonlight Sonata
songs.description: One of the most recognised piano pieces in the world, in three movements.
songs.educational_notes: The popular 'moonlight' nickname was given by critic Ludwig Rellstab after Beethoven's death.
songs.fun_fact: The popular 'moonlight' nickname was given by critic Ludwig Rellstab after Beethoven's death.

songs.title: Für Elise
songs.description: A gentle piano bagatelle, one of the first classical pieces many children learn.
songs.educational_notes: The identity of 'Elise' is still debated by music historians.
songs.fun_fact: The identity of 'Elise' is still debated by music historians.

songs.title: Eine Kleine Nachtmusik
songs.description: A playful, cheerful serenade for strings — Mozart's most popular composition.
songs.educational_notes: Written in just a few days; Mozart was working on Don Giovanni at the same time.
songs.fun_fact: Written in just a few days; Mozart was working on Don Giovanni at the same time.

songs.title: Ave Maria
songs.description: One of the most cherished sacred songs in Western classical music.
songs.educational_notes: Based on a poem from Sir Walter Scott's narrative poem The Lady of the Lake.
songs.fun_fact: Based on a poem from Sir Walter Scott's narrative poem The Lady of the Lake.

songs.title: Clair de Lune
songs.description: The third movement of Debussy's Suite bergamasque — dreamy and luminous.
songs.educational_notes: The title means 'moonlight' in French, inspired by a Paul Verlaine poem.
songs.fun_fact: The title means 'moonlight' in French, inspired by a Paul Verlaine poem.

songs.title: Smooth
songs.description: Carlos Santana's Grammy-sweeping collaboration with Rob Thomas of Matchbox Twenty.
songs.educational_notes: Won three Grammy Awards in a single night including Record of the Year.
songs.fun_fact: Won three Grammy Awards in a single night including Record of the Year.

songs.title: Oye Como Va
songs.description: A classic Tito Puente composition reinvented by Santana with rock guitar.
songs.educational_notes: Tito Puente originally wrote it in 1963; Santana's version made it a global hit.
songs.fun_fact: Tito Puente originally wrote it in 1963; Santana's version made it a global hit.

songs.title: La Bamba
songs.description: A traditional Mexican folk song transformed into rock and roll by Ritchie Valens.
songs.educational_notes: Became a Top 25 hit despite most US radio listeners not understanding Spanish.
songs.fun_fact: Became a Top 25 hit despite most US radio listeners not understanding Spanish.

songs.title: Livin' la Vida Loca
songs.description: The Latin pop explosion that launched a global Latin music wave in 1999.
songs.educational_notes: Became the first #1 single of the SoundScan/BDS monitored era in Latin pop.
songs.fun_fact: Became the first #1 single of the SoundScan/BDS monitored era in Latin pop.

songs.title: Waka Waka (This Time for Africa)
songs.description: The official song of the 2010 FIFA World Cup held in South Africa.
songs.educational_notes: Based on a Cameroonian army chant called 'Zangalewa'.
songs.fun_fact: Based on a Cameroonian army chant called 'Zangalewa'.

songs.title: Hips Don't Lie
songs.description: One of the best-selling singles of all time, blending Latin and Caribbean rhythms.
songs.educational_notes: Spent over 55 weeks on the Billboard charts.
songs.fun_fact: Spent over 55 weeks on the Billboard charts.

songs.title: Guantanamera
songs.description: Cuba's most famous song, based on José Martí's patriotic poetry.
songs.educational_notes: Literally means 'woman from Guantánamo'; the melody is drawn from a Cuban son.
songs.fun_fact: Literally means 'woman from Guantánamo'; the melody is drawn from a Cuban son.

songs.title: Chan Chan
songs.description: The opening track of the Grammy-winning Buena Vista Social Club album.
songs.educational_notes: Written by Compay Segundo; the repetitive bass riff is iconic in Cuban music.
songs.fun_fact: Written by Compay Segundo; the repetitive bass riff is iconic in Cuban music.

songs.title: Mas Que Nada
songs.album: Herb Alpert Presents Sérgio Mendes & Brasil '66
songs.description: A bossa nova classic composed by Jorge Ben Jor, popularised globally by Sérgio Mendes.
songs.educational_notes: The 2006 Black Eyed Peas remix brought it to a new generation.
songs.fun_fact: The 2006 Black Eyed Peas remix brought it to a new generation.

songs.title: The Girl from Ipanema
songs.description: The song that introduced bossa nova to the world — the second most recorded song ever.
songs.educational_notes: Astrud Gilberto's English vocal was recorded spontaneously in the studio.
songs.fun_fact: Astrud Gilberto's English vocal was recorded spontaneously in the studio.

songs.title: Lambada
songs.description: The global dance hit of 1989 that sparked a lambada dance craze worldwide.
songs.educational_notes: Based on a Bolivian huayno melody; the original composers won a copyright lawsuit.
songs.fun_fact: Based on a Bolivian huayno melody; the original composers won a copyright lawsuit.

songs.title: Pata Pata
songs.description: Miriam Makeba's joyful signature song, originally recorded in 1956.
songs.educational_notes: The title is Xhosa slang for 'touch touch'; the dance mimics the meaning.
songs.fun_fact: The title is Xhosa slang for 'touch touch'; the dance mimics the meaning.

songs.title: Click Song (Qongqothwane)
songs.description: Famous for its Xhosa click consonants, showcasing the richness of African languages.
songs.educational_notes: Makeba performed it at John F. Kennedy's birthday gala in 1962.
songs.fun_fact: Makeba performed it at John F. Kennedy's birthday gala in 1962.

songs.title: 7 Seconds
songs.description: A duet celebrating the innocence of children before the world shapes their views.
songs.educational_notes: Topped charts in France and many European countries for weeks.
songs.fun_fact: Topped charts in France and many European countries for weeks.

songs.title: Agolo
songs.description: A powerful tribute to Mother Earth blending West African rhythms with pop.
songs.educational_notes: Kidjo went on to win multiple Grammy Awards; Agolo remains her signature song.
songs.fun_fact: Kidjo went on to win multiple Grammy Awards; Agolo remains her signature song.

songs.title: Sweet Mother
songs.description: One of the best-selling African singles of all time — a tribute to mothers.
songs.educational_notes: Sold over 13 million copies, making it one of the biggest African hits ever.
songs.fun_fact: Sold over 13 million copies, making it one of the biggest African hits ever.

songs.title: Ye
songs.description: A contemporary Afrobeats anthem about contentment and gratitude.
songs.educational_notes: Helped launch Burna Boy's international breakthrough.
songs.fun_fact: Helped launch Burna Boy's international breakthrough.

songs.title: Jana Gana Mana
songs.description: India's national anthem, composed by Rabindranath Tagore in Bengali.
songs.educational_notes: First sung at the Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress in 1911.
songs.fun_fact: First sung at the Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress in 1911.

songs.title: Jai Ho
songs.description: Academy Award-winning song from the film Slumdog Millionaire.
songs.educational_notes: A.R. Rahman won two Oscars for the film's music, a first for Indian music.
songs.fun_fact: A.R. Rahman won two Oscars for the film's music, a first for Indian music.

songs.title: Roja Jaaneman
songs.description: The title song from the groundbreaking Mani Ratnam film that launched A.R. Rahman.
songs.educational_notes: Won the National Film Award and made Rahman a household name across India.
songs.fun_fact: Won the National Film Award and made Rahman a household name across India.

songs.title: Teri Mitti
songs.description: An emotional tribute to soldiers, sung by the nightingale of India, Lata Mangeshkar.
songs.educational_notes: Won the Filmfare Award for Best Lyricist and deeply moved audiences across India.
songs.fun_fact: Won the Filmfare Award for Best Lyricist and deeply moved audiences across India.

songs.title: Awara Hoon
songs.description: One of the most globally popular Bollywood songs, especially loved in Soviet Russia and China.
songs.educational_notes: The film Awaara was one of the highest-grossing films worldwide in 1951.
songs.fun_fact: The film Awaara was one of the highest-grossing films worldwide in 1951.

songs.title: Gangnam Style
songs.description: First YouTube video to reach 1 billion views; launched the global K-pop wave.
songs.educational_notes: Named after the Gangnam district of Seoul, known for its wealthy lifestyle.
songs.fun_fact: Named after the Gangnam district of Seoul, known for its wealthy lifestyle.

songs.title: Dynamite
songs.description: BTS's first all-English single, released during the COVID-19 pandemic to spread joy.
songs.educational_notes: Debuted at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100, a first for a Korean act.
songs.fun_fact: Debuted at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100, a first for a Korean act.

songs.title: Butter
songs.description: A feel-good summer anthem that broke multiple streaming records.
songs.educational_notes: Spent 10 consecutive weeks at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.
songs.fun_fact: Spent 10 consecutive weeks at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

songs.title: Sakura
songs.description: A beloved Japanese song about cherry blossoms and farewell — deeply tied to graduation season.
songs.educational_notes: Consistently ranked among Japan's most-loved songs of the 2000s.
songs.fun_fact: Consistently ranked among Japan's most-loved songs of the 2000s.

songs.title: Ue o Muite Arukō (Sukiyaki)
songs.description: The only Japanese-language song to reach #1 on the US Billboard Hot 100.
songs.educational_notes: Billboard renamed it 'Sukiyaki' — a Japanese dish — as the real title was hard to market.
songs.fun_fact: Billboard renamed it 'Sukiyaki' — a Japanese dish — as the real title was hard to market.

songs.title: Enta Omri
songs.description: One of the greatest Arabic songs ever written — a live performance typically lasted hours.
songs.educational_notes: Umm Kulthum would repeat verses spontaneously based on audience response.
songs.fun_fact: Umm Kulthum would repeat verses spontaneously based on audience response.

songs.title: Nassam Alayna Al-Hawa
songs.description: One of Fairuz's most beloved melodies, evoking longing and nostalgia.
songs.educational_notes: Fairuz is considered the most important Arab female singer of the 20th century.
songs.fun_fact: Fairuz is considered the most important Arab female singer of the 20th century.

songs.title: Habibi Ya Nour El Ain
songs.description: Blending Egyptian pop with Mediterranean and Western influences — a global Arabic pop hit.
songs.educational_notes: Won the World Music Award for Best Selling Middle Eastern Artist.
songs.fun_fact: Won the World Music Award for Best Selling Middle Eastern Artist.

songs.title: Zombie
songs.description: A protest song about the Troubles in Northern Ireland, written by Dolores O'Riordan.
songs.educational_notes: Written after two young boys were killed in an IRA bomb attack in Warrington.
songs.fun_fact: Written after two young boys were killed in an IRA bomb attack in Warrington.

songs.title: Linger

songs.educational_notes: Frequently sung at football matches; commonly played at funerals in the UK.
songs.fun_fact: Frequently sung at football matches; commonly played at funerals in the UK.

songs.title: Amar Sonar Bangla
songs.description: Bangladesh's national anthem, written by Nobel Laureate Rabindranath Tagore.
songs.educational_notes: First sung at the 1905 Indian National Congress session in Benaras; adopted by Bangladesh in 1971.
songs.fun_fact: First sung at the 1905 Indian National Congress session in Benaras; adopted by Bangladesh in 1971.

songs.title: Ekla Cholo Re
songs.description: A call to walk alone with courage — Mahatma Gandhi's favourite Tagore song.
songs.educational_notes: The phrase 'Ekla Cholo Re' is engraved on many public monuments across Bengal.
songs.fun_fact: The phrase 'Ekla Cholo Re' is engraved on many public monuments across Bengal.

songs.title: Aguner Poroshmoni
songs.description: A devotional prayer to the fire of inspiration — a beloved Rabindra Sangeet.
songs.educational_notes: One of Tagore's own favourite compositions; sung at dawn prayer gatherings.
songs.fun_fact: One of Tagore's own favourite compositions; sung at dawn prayer gatherings.

songs.title: Tumi Robe Nirobe
songs.description: A serene Puja song about the silent, ever-present divine — deeply spiritual.
songs.educational_notes: Used extensively in Tagore's dance-dramas (Nrityanatya).
songs.fun_fact: Used extensively in Tagore's dance-dramas (Nrityanatya).

songs.title: Jodi Tor Dak Shune Keu Na Ase
songs.description: Linked with 'Ekla Cholo Re' — an anthem of solitary courage against all odds.
songs.educational_notes: Sung widely during the independence movements of both India and Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Sung widely during the independence movements of both India and Bangladesh.

songs.title: Purano Shei Diner Kotha
songs.description: A song of fond remembrance for old friends and childhood days.
songs.educational_notes: Often sung at reunions; melody adapted from a Scottish folk tune by Tagore.
songs.fun_fact: Often sung at reunions; melody adapted from a Scottish folk tune by Tagore.

songs.title: Bhalobeshe Shokhi Nibhrite Jotone
songs.description: A romantic Tagore song about keeping love alive in quiet devotion.
songs.educational_notes: One of the most frequently sung romantic Rabindra Sangeet compositions.
songs.fun_fact: One of the most frequently sung romantic Rabindra Sangeet compositions.

songs.title: Aaji Banglader Hridoy Hote
songs.description: A celebration of Bengal's spirit and beauty — connects deeply with Bangladeshis.
songs.educational_notes: Frequently performed on national and cultural occasions in Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Frequently performed on national and cultural occasions in Bangladesh.

songs.title: Amader Shontan
songs.description: A song about the hope and joy that children bring to the world.
songs.educational_notes: Written for a children's festival and remains popular in school programmes.
songs.fun_fact: Written for a children's festival and remains popular in school programmes.

songs.title: Megh Boleche Jabo Jabo
songs.description: A monsoon song describing the departing clouds — evoking longing and beauty.
songs.educational_notes: Tagore wrote many monsoon songs (Barkha); this is among the finest.
songs.fun_fact: Tagore wrote many monsoon songs (Barkha); this is among the finest.

songs.title: Amar Matha Nato Kore Dao
songs.description: A prayer for humility and inner surrender — deeply spiritual and meditative.
songs.educational_notes: Widely used as an opening prayer at Rabindranath's annual celebrations.
songs.fun_fact: Widely used as an opening prayer at Rabindranath's annual celebrations.

songs.title: Phule Phule Dhole Dhole
songs.description: A joyful spring song — flowers swaying, trees blooming in celebration.
songs.educational_notes: One of Tagore's best-loved nature songs (Prakriti Paryay).
songs.fun_fact: One of Tagore's best-loved nature songs (Prakriti Paryay).

songs.title: Aamar Shonar Desh Re
songs.description: A patriotic ode to Bengal's golden fields and rivers.
songs.educational_notes: This song is considered a cultural twin to 'Amar Sonar Bangla'.
songs.fun_fact: This song is considered a cultural twin to 'Amar Sonar Bangla'.

songs.title: Biday
songs.description: A farewell song of parting and separation — gentle, emotional and profound.
songs.educational_notes: Sung at graduations, farewells and partings across Bengal.
songs.fun_fact: Sung at graduations, farewells and partings across Bengal.

songs.title: Nil Digante
songs.description: A meditative song about the blue horizon — nature as a spiritual metaphor.
songs.educational_notes: One of Tagore's late-period masterpieces.
songs.fun_fact: One of Tagore's late-period masterpieces.

songs.title: Goriye Dao Goriye Dao
songs.description: A classical Puja song in Hindustani Yaman Kalyan raga — majestic and serene.
songs.educational_notes: Combines Bengali devotion with classical Hindustani raga architecture.
songs.fun_fact: Combines Bengali devotion with classical Hindustani raga architecture.

songs.title: Ami Chini Go Chini Tomare
songs.description: A romantic song of recognition — the beloved recognised across lives and time.
songs.educational_notes: One of Tagore's most celebrated love songs (Prem Paryay).
songs.fun_fact: One of Tagore's most celebrated love songs (Prem Paryay).

songs.title: Bajao Bajao
songs.description: A joyful festive song calling everyone to play their instruments and celebrate.
songs.educational_notes: Sung at Rabindra Jayanti (Tagore's birthday) celebrations every year.
songs.fun_fact: Sung at Rabindra Jayanti (Tagore's birthday) celebrations every year.

songs.title: Jokhon Porbe Na Mor
songs.description: One of Tagore's final songs — a reflection on mortality and the legacy of one's life.
songs.educational_notes: Written when Tagore was gravely ill; considered among his most profound compositions.
songs.fun_fact: Written when Tagore was gravely ill; considered among his most profound compositions.

songs.title: Tomar Holo Shuru
songs.description: A welcoming, celebratory song heralding a new beginning.
songs.educational_notes: Sung to welcome the Bengali New Year (Pohela Boishakh).
songs.fun_fact: Sung to welcome the Bengali New Year (Pohela Boishakh).

songs.title: Rongino Sheje Jai
songs.description: A spring festival song (Holi) celebrating colour and joy.
songs.educational_notes: Tagore composed several Holi songs celebrating the festival of colours.
songs.fun_fact: Tagore composed several Holi songs celebrating the festival of colours.

songs.title: Akash Bhora Surjo Tara
songs.description: A vision of the cosmos filled with stars and sunlight — Tagore's cosmic prayer.
songs.educational_notes: One of the most sung Tagore compositions at dawn prayer gatherings.
songs.fun_fact: One of the most sung Tagore compositions at dawn prayer gatherings.

songs.title: Praner Khushi
songs.description: A joyful song celebrating the happiness of being alive.
songs.educational_notes: Captures Tagore's philosophy of Ananda (bliss) — joy as a form of worship.
songs.fun_fact: Captures Tagore's philosophy of Ananda (bliss) — joy as a form of worship.

songs.title: Chokhe Ami Chini Tomay
songs.description: A romantic recognition song — discovering the beloved's soul through the eyes.
songs.educational_notes: A favourite among Tagore's romantic compositions (Prem Paryay).
songs.fun_fact: A favourite among Tagore's romantic compositions (Prem Paryay).

songs.title: Shey Je Boshe Ache Eka
songs.description: A meditative Puja song about the divine presence waiting in solitude.
songs.educational_notes: Deeply meditative; one of Tagore's most introspective compositions.
songs.fun_fact: Deeply meditative; one of Tagore's most introspective compositions.

songs.title: Bidrohi
songs.description: Nazrul's revolutionary poem-song — 'I am the rebel, I am eternal revolt.'
songs.educational_notes: Written in one sitting; published in the Bengali literary magazine Bijli.
songs.fun_fact: Written in one sitting; published in the Bengali literary magazine Bijli.

songs.title: Chal Chal Chal
songs.description: A marching patriotic song that became a revolutionary anthem during British rule.
songs.educational_notes: Used as a rallying cry during the independence movements across South Asia.
songs.fun_fact: Used as a rallying cry during the independence movements across South Asia.

songs.title: Nishi Raat Baoka Chand
songs.description: A romantic Nazrul song about the moon and the night — lyrical and tender.
songs.educational_notes: One of the most loved Nazrul romantic compositions (Prem Geeti).
songs.fun_fact: One of the most loved Nazrul romantic compositions (Prem Geeti).

songs.title: Mora Ekti Phul Ke Bachabo Bole
songs.description: Adopted as a stirring liberation song during Bangladesh's 1971 War of Independence.
songs.educational_notes: The song was broadcast on Shadhin Bangla Betar Kendra during the war.
songs.fun_fact: The song was broadcast on Shadhin Bangla Betar Kendra during the war.

songs.title: Karar Oi Louha Kopat
songs.description: A fiery song demanding the breaking of prison gates — a symbol of liberation.
songs.educational_notes: Written while Nazrul was imprisoned by the British government.
songs.fun_fact: Written while Nazrul was imprisoned by the British government.

songs.title: Shongkochero Bihwolata
songs.description: A devotional song expressing surrender to the divine with humility.
songs.educational_notes: A beloved Bhakti Geeti composition from Nazrul's devotional song collection.
songs.fun_fact: A beloved Bhakti Geeti composition from Nazrul's devotional song collection.

songs.title: Bhulbo Na Bhulbo Na
songs.description: A poignant Nazrul love song about unforgettable memories and farewell.
songs.educational_notes: One of Nazrul's most emotionally resonant romantic compositions.
songs.fun_fact: One of Nazrul's most emotionally resonant romantic compositions.

songs.title: Agni Vina
songs.description: The title song of Nazrul's first poetry collection — a fire-and-thunder vision of revolt.
songs.educational_notes: Agni Vina (Lute of Fire) was published after Nazrul's release from prison.
songs.fun_fact: Agni Vina (Lute of Fire) was published after Nazrul's release from prison.

songs.title: Tomari Tore Ei Jibon
songs.description: A devotional-romantic hybrid — dedicating one's entire existence to the beloved.
songs.educational_notes: Reflects Nazrul's synthesis of love and spirituality in his Prem Geeti.
songs.fun_fact: Reflects Nazrul's synthesis of love and spirituality in his Prem Geeti.

songs.title: Brishtir Sur
songs.description: A Nazrul monsoon song — the rhythm of rain as the rhythm of the heart.
songs.educational_notes: Nazrul's rain songs (Brishti Geeti) capture Bengal's monsoon with unique lyricism.
songs.fun_fact: Nazrul's rain songs (Brishti Geeti) capture Bengal's monsoon with unique lyricism.

songs.title: Khela Shesh Hoye Gelo
songs.description: A meditative song about the end of life's play — spiritual and accepting.
songs.educational_notes: Written during Nazrul's later years; reflects his Sufi-influenced spirituality.
songs.fun_fact: Written during Nazrul's later years; reflects his Sufi-influenced spirituality.

songs.title: Mrityu Ke Khele Pujibo
songs.description: Nazrul's fearless song about embracing death as a joyful passage.
songs.educational_notes: Embodies Nazrul's revolutionary spirit — even towards death he was defiant.
songs.fun_fact: Embodies Nazrul's revolutionary spirit — even towards death he was defiant.

songs.title: Jao Jao Mone
songs.description: A bittersweet farewell romantic song, deeply rooted in Bengali musical tradition.
songs.educational_notes: Typical of Nazrul's Prem Geeti — passionate yet melancholic.
songs.fun_fact: Typical of Nazrul's Prem Geeti — passionate yet melancholic.

songs.title: Dol Dol Dolani
songs.description: A playful swinging song written for children — joyful and rhythmic.
songs.educational_notes: Nazrul wrote many children's songs (Shishu Geeti) alongside his revolutionary work.
songs.fun_fact: Nazrul wrote many children's songs (Shishu Geeti) alongside his revolutionary work.

songs.title: Purbodikkhone Jhar Astese
songs.description: A storm-song of revolution — the thunder coming from the east.
songs.educational_notes: The storm is a metaphor for colonial subjects rising against oppression.
songs.fun_fact: The storm is a metaphor for colonial subjects rising against oppression.

songs.title: Shob Loke Koy Lalon Ki Jat
songs.description: Lalon Fakir's most famous song questioning caste, religion and identity.
songs.educational_notes: One of the greatest philosophical songs in the Bengali tradition; translated into many languages.
songs.fun_fact: One of the greatest philosophical songs in the Bengali tradition; translated into many languages.

songs.title: Khachaar Bhitor Ochin Pakhi
songs.description: A Baul song about the unknown bird (soul) trapped in the cage (body).
songs.educational_notes: A masterpiece of Baul mystical poetry; endlessly interpreted by scholars and musicians.
songs.fun_fact: A masterpiece of Baul mystical poetry; endlessly interpreted by scholars and musicians.

songs.title: Dekhna Mon Jhokmariaa
songs.description: A Baul folk song about the nature of the soul — philosophical and searching.
songs.educational_notes: Lalon's songs reject all religious distinctions and celebrate human unity.
songs.fun_fact: Lalon's songs reject all religious distinctions and celebrate human unity.

songs.title: Maner Manush
songs.description: Lalon's quest for the 'man within' — the inner divine consciousness.
songs.educational_notes: The film Moner Manush (2010) by Goutam Ghosh brought this to global audiences.
songs.fun_fact: The film Moner Manush (2010) by Goutam Ghosh brought this to global audiences.

songs.title: Guru Doyal Bina Aar Ki Aache
songs.description: A devotional Baul song celebrating the spiritual guide (guru) as the path to enlightenment.
songs.educational_notes: Central to Baul philosophy — the guru leads the seeker to the divine within.
songs.fun_fact: Central to Baul philosophy — the guru leads the seeker to the divine within.

songs.title: Nodir Kinaare
songs.description: A traditional Bhatiali river song — the longing of the boatman on the river.
songs.educational_notes: Bhatiali songs are the folk music of Bangladesh's river communities.
songs.fun_fact: Bhatiali songs are the folk music of Bangladesh's river communities.

songs.title: Ami Bhai Kangal
songs.description: Shah Abdul Karim's self-deprecating Baul — the poor wandering singer seeking truth.
songs.educational_notes: Shah Abdul Karim (1916-2009) was the last great Baul master of Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Shah Abdul Karim (1916-2009) was the last great Baul master of Bangladesh.

songs.title: Gaan Geye Parichoy
songs.description: A Baul song about music as the only identity — the singer's soul revealed through song.
songs.educational_notes: One of Shah Abdul Karim's most celebrated compositions.
songs.fun_fact: One of Shah Abdul Karim's most celebrated compositions.

songs.title: Banglar Mati
songs.description: A folk song celebrating Bangladesh's soil — rivers, paddy fields and seasons.
songs.educational_notes: Sung across Bangladesh at cultural events and national celebrations.
songs.fun_fact: Sung across Bangladesh at cultural events and national celebrations.

songs.title: Amar Shonar Bangla (Folk)
songs.description: The traditional folk melody that inspired Tagore's composition of the national anthem.
songs.educational_notes: The interplay between Tagore's literary version and the original folk melody is celebrated.
songs.fun_fact: The interplay between Tagore's literary version and the original folk melody is celebrated.

songs.title: Kaiche Koiche Bole
songs.description: A Jarigan folk song — the call-and-response tradition of rural Bengal.
songs.educational_notes: Jarigan is a narrative folk genre performed competitively in rural Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Jarigan is a narrative folk genre performed competitively in rural Bangladesh.

songs.title: Muri Khabar Shesh
songs.description: A humorous Baul folk song about simple village pleasures and contentment.
songs.educational_notes: Baul music includes both profound mystical songs and light-hearted folk verses.
songs.fun_fact: Baul music includes both profound mystical songs and light-hearted folk verses.

songs.title: Nodi Amar Ma
songs.description: A Bhatiali song personifying the river as the singer's mother — deeply emotional.
songs.educational_notes: Bhatiali river songs are the soul of riverine Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Bhatiali river songs are the soul of riverine Bangladesh.

songs.title: Haor Baor Jol
songs.description: A Sylheti folk song about the haor wetlands — distinctive northern Bengali dialect.
songs.educational_notes: Sylheti folk songs have a distinct rhythm and scale from other Bengali folk traditions.
songs.fun_fact: Sylheti folk songs have a distinct rhythm and scale from other Bengali folk traditions.

songs.title: Hare Krishna Kirtan
songs.description: The devotional chant tradition of Vaishnavism — call-and-response prayer singing.
songs.educational_notes: Kirtan has been practised in Bengal for over 500 years; Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was its founder.
songs.fun_fact: Kirtan has been practised in Bengal for over 500 years; Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was its founder.

songs.title: Ami Bhawaiya Gaaibo Hoy
songs.description: A Bhawaiah folk song from northern Bengal — the longing of the cowherd (gowalini).
songs.educational_notes: Bhawaiah is the distinctive folk genre of Rangpur and Rajshahi regions.
songs.fun_fact: Bhawaiah is the distinctive folk genre of Rangpur and Rajshahi regions.

songs.title: Murshidi Gaan
songs.description: A Sufi devotional song about longing for the divine guide (murshid).
songs.educational_notes: Murshidi songs are the mystical counterpart to Baul songs in Bangladeshi folk tradition.
songs.fun_fact: Murshidi songs are the mystical counterpart to Baul songs in Bangladeshi folk tradition.

songs.title: Shari Khela
songs.description: A harvest festival folk song celebrating the season of abundance.
songs.educational_notes: Sung during the Nobanno harvest festival in rural Bangladesh and West Bengal.
songs.fun_fact: Sung during the Nobanno harvest festival in rural Bangladesh and West Bengal.

songs.title: Karbala Kande
songs.description: A traditional narrative folk song lamenting the Battle of Karbala — deeply emotional.
songs.educational_notes: Jari Gaan is the narrative ballad tradition of Bangladesh, often sung at Muharram.
songs.fun_fact: Jari Gaan is the narrative ballad tradition of Bangladesh, often sung at Muharram.

songs.title: Dhamail
songs.description: A traditional women's song sung at weddings and celebrations in Sylhet.
songs.educational_notes: Dhamail is performed in a circle dance unique to the Sylhet region of Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Dhamail is performed in a circle dance unique to the Sylhet region of Bangladesh.

songs.title: Sei Tumi
songs.description: One of Bangladesh's most iconic heavy metal songs — brooding and powerful.
songs.educational_notes: Warfaze, formed in 1984, is the pioneer of Bangladeshi heavy metal music.
songs.fun_fact: Warfaze, formed in 1984, is the pioneer of Bangladeshi heavy metal music.

songs.title: Bohemian
songs.description: Warfaze's progressive rock anthem — influenced by Queen and Iron Maiden.
songs.educational_notes: The term 'bohemian' in Bangla rock became synonymous with Warfaze's free spirit.
songs.fun_fact: The term 'bohemian' in Bangla rock became synonymous with Warfaze's free spirit.

songs.title: Priya
songs.description: Miles' enduring love ballad — one of the best-loved Bangladeshi rock songs ever.
songs.educational_notes: Miles, formed in 1979, is the oldest and most respected rock band of Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Miles, formed in 1979, is the oldest and most respected rock band of Bangladesh.

songs.title: Phirey Eso
songs.description: A heartfelt Miles ballad about longing for someone to come back.
songs.educational_notes: Miles blended Western rock with Bengali sensitivity — this song exemplifies that.
songs.fun_fact: Miles blended Western rock with Bengali sensitivity — this song exemplifies that.

songs.title: Neel Matro
songs.description: Shironamhin's debut classic — complex, layered and deeply emotional.
songs.educational_notes: Shironamhin (means 'untitled') brought progressive rock sophistication to Bangladeshi music.
songs.fun_fact: Shironamhin (means 'untitled') brought progressive rock sophistication to Bangladeshi music.

songs.title: Hasnuhena
songs.description: One of the greatest Bangladeshi rock songs — epic in scope and emotional depth.
songs.educational_notes: Artcell's debut album Onno Shomoy is considered the masterpiece of Bangladeshi rock.
songs.fun_fact: Artcell's debut album Onno Shomoy is considered the masterpiece of Bangladeshi rock.

songs.title: Abujh Mon
songs.description: Artcell's anthem of restlessness and inner conflict — beloved by Bangladeshi youth.
songs.educational_notes: Artcell pioneered progressive metal in Bangladesh with intricate guitar work.
songs.fun_fact: Artcell pioneered progressive metal in Bangladesh with intricate guitar work.

songs.title: Cholo Bodle Jai
songs.description: A call to change and revolution — Nemesis' signature socially conscious anthem.
songs.educational_notes: Nemesis blends rock with rap and socially aware lyrics unique in Bangladeshi rock.
songs.fun_fact: Nemesis blends rock with rap and socially aware lyrics unique in Bangladeshi rock.

songs.title: Koshto
songs.description: A raw, emotional song about pain and endurance — deeply relatable.
songs.educational_notes: One of Nemesis' most streamed songs; reflects contemporary urban Bangladeshi life.
songs.fun_fact: One of Nemesis' most streamed songs; reflects contemporary urban Bangladeshi life.

songs.title: Shada Shada Kala Kala
songs.description: The haunting folk-pop anthem from the acclaimed Bangladeshi film Hawa.
songs.educational_notes: The song went viral across Bangladesh and the Bengali diaspora in 2022.
songs.fun_fact: The song went viral across Bangladesh and the Bengali diaspora in 2022.

songs.title: Baba
songs.description: Habib Wahid's emotional tribute to fatherhood — became a Father's Day anthem.
songs.educational_notes: Habib Wahid's acoustic fusion style created a new genre in Bangladeshi pop music.
songs.fun_fact: Habib Wahid's acoustic fusion style created a new genre in Bangladeshi pop music.

songs.title: Keu Bujhena
songs.description: A folk-infused pop song about being misunderstood — resonant and emotional.
songs.educational_notes: Habib Wahid popularised the fusion of Baul folk with modern pop arrangement.
songs.fun_fact: Habib Wahid popularised the fusion of Baul folk with modern pop arrangement.

songs.title: Deyal
songs.description: Chirkutt's signature indie-folk fusion — folk instruments with modern pop production.
songs.educational_notes: Chirkutt (meaning little bird) popularised the indie-folk sound in Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Chirkutt (meaning little bird) popularised the indie-folk sound in Bangladesh.

songs.title: Keu Nei
songs.description: A melancholic indie-folk song about loneliness — understated and beautiful.
songs.educational_notes: Chirkutt's collaborations with Indian musicians extended Bangladesh's musical reach.
songs.fun_fact: Chirkutt's collaborations with Indian musicians extended Bangladesh's musical reach.

songs.title: Shei Tumi Keno Eto Ochena
songs.description: LRB's (Love Runs Blind) most beloved ballad — one of Bangladesh's greatest love songs.
songs.educational_notes: LRB was led by Ayub Bachchu, Bangladesh's greatest rock guitarist.
songs.fun_fact: LRB was led by Ayub Bachchu, Bangladesh's greatest rock guitarist.

songs.title: Rupali Guitar
songs.description: A tribute to the guitar and to music — Ayub Bachchu's most iconic song.
songs.educational_notes: Rupali means 'silver'; the song is a love letter from a musician to his instrument.
songs.fun_fact: Rupali means 'silver'; the song is a love letter from a musician to his instrument.

songs.title: Sob Kota Janala Khule Dao
songs.description: James' call to open every window to let in light and freedom — an optimistic anthem.
songs.educational_notes: James (Faruk Mahfuz Anam) is one of Bangladesh's most distinctive pop rock vocalists.
songs.fun_fact: James (Faruk Mahfuz Anam) is one of Bangladesh's most distinctive pop rock vocalists.

songs.title: Naksha
songs.description: James' introspective song about life's blueprint — philosophical and unique.
songs.educational_notes: James' distinctive vocal style set him apart in the Bangladeshi music landscape.
songs.fun_fact: James' distinctive vocal style set him apart in the Bangladeshi music landscape.

songs.title: Kochi Pathar Gaan
songs.description: Souls' tender nature song — the sound of green leaves and soft rain.
songs.educational_notes: Souls, formed in 1972 in Chittagong, is Bangladesh's oldest surviving rock band.
songs.fun_fact: Souls, formed in 1972 in Chittagong, is Bangladesh's oldest surviving rock band.

songs.title: Koshto Pailam
songs.description: Maqsudul Haque's blues-inflected rock about suffering and resilience.
songs.educational_notes: Maqsudul Haque (Mac), former frontman of Feedback, defined early Bangladeshi rock.
songs.fun_fact: Maqsudul Haque (Mac), former frontman of Feedback, defined early Bangladeshi rock.

songs.title: Tumi Chharay
songs.description: Feedback's classic rock ballad — raw and honest, a cornerstone of Bangladeshi rock.
songs.educational_notes: Feedback, formed in 1973, was the second-oldest rock band in Bangladesh.
songs.fun_fact: Feedback, formed in 1973, was the second-oldest rock band in Bangladesh.

songs.title: Bali
songs.description: Anusheh Anadil's experimental fusion of raga, folk and world music.
songs.educational_notes: Anusheh Anadil is celebrated for bridging Bangladeshi classical, folk and world music.
songs.fun_fact: Anusheh Anadil is celebrated for bridging Bangladeshi classical, folk and world music.

songs.title: Kontho
songs.description: Arnob's heartfelt folk-pop song about voice and communication — minimalist and beautiful.
songs.educational_notes: Arnob is known for his sparse, emotionally resonant acoustic folk arrangements.
songs.fun_fact: Arnob is known for his sparse, emotionally resonant acoustic folk arrangements.

songs.title: Bhalobasha Mane
songs.description: Tahsan's radio-friendly love song that became a hit across Bangladesh.
songs.educational_notes: Tahsan Khan became one of Bangladesh's most popular pop-rock artists in the 2000s.
songs.fun_fact: Tahsan Khan became one of Bangladesh's most popular pop-rock artists in the 2000s.

songs.title: Ore Griho Bashi
songs.description: A classic folk song beautifully rearranged in contemporary style by Arnob.
songs.educational_notes: The reinvention of traditional folk songs by modern artists is a vibrant Bangladeshi musical tradition.
songs.fun_fact: The reinvention of traditional folk songs by modern artists is a vibrant Bangladeshi musical tradition.

songs.title: Shei Je Ami Nei
songs.description: Runa Laila's signature Bangladeshi film song — full of longing and vocal mastery.
songs.educational_notes: Runa Laila is the Queen of Bangladeshi and Pakistani music; her career spans six decades.
songs.fun_fact: Runa Laila is the Queen of Bangladeshi and Pakistani music; her career spans six decades.

songs.title: Dakle Kuhu Boro Bhalobasha
songs.description: A beloved Runa Laila film song featuring her distinctive high soprano voice.
songs.educational_notes: Runa Laila performed for both Bangladesh and Pakistan — a cross-border music icon.
songs.fun_fact: Runa Laila performed for both Bangladesh and Pakistan — a cross-border music icon.

songs.title: Bondhu Tin Din
songs.description: Andrew Kishore's iconic male-voice film song — a beloved Bangladeshi classic.
songs.educational_notes: Andrew Kishore is the most celebrated male playback singer in Bangladeshi film history.
songs.fun_fact: Andrew Kishore is the most celebrated male playback singer in Bangladeshi film history.

songs.title: Amar Shona Bangla
songs.description: Andrew Kishore's patriotic film song celebrating the beauty of Bangladesh.
songs.educational_notes: Andrew Kishore has sung over 15,000 songs for Bangladeshi films.
songs.fun_fact: Andrew Kishore has sung over 15,000 songs for Bangladeshi films.

songs.title: Aaj Ei Din Take
songs.description: Kumar Sanu's popular Bengali playback song — his smooth voice made him a crossover star.
